lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds.|Mine is a list of winters.
lines.text: Malrik tells his life as a list of wounds. Mine is a list of winters.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I was born on that hill, the year|nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.
lines.text: I was born on that hill, the year nothing grew. Not one blade of grass.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: My mother buried seed in the snow.|The village laughed. I watched it sleep.
lines.text: My mother buried seed in the snow. The village laughed. I watched it sleep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: In spring it came up green. I have|never forgotten how that felt.
lines.text: In spring it came up green. I have never forgotten how that felt.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: A tall man with a burning hem found me|coaxing a sapling through the frost.
lines.text: A tall man with a burning hem found me coaxing a sapling through the frost.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: He said: show me again. So I did,|for twenty years, until he was gone.
lines.text: He said: show me again. So I did, for twenty years, until he was gone.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow.|Slow is how an oak outlives an army.
lines.text: They call me soft. Neutral. Slow. Slow is how an oak outlives an army.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Last winter they burned my wood|and froze the ashes. My army with it.
lines.text: Last winter they burned my wood and froze the ashes. My army with it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I knelt in the black, and I waited.|Something green came up. It always does.
lines.text: I knelt in the black, and I waited. Something green came up. It always does.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: That is my strength.|I come back. Every spring. Every time.
lines.text: That is my strength. I come back. Every spring. Every time.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The Master planted this country with his|own hands. He left it to me to keep.
lines.text: The Master planted this country with his own hands. He left it to me to keep.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Malrik stands up there with his candle,|his stone, and Torvald's winter.
lines.text: Malrik stands up there with his candle, his stone, and Torvald's winter.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.
lines.text: Let them come. Cut it. Burn it. Freeze it.
